source.text_it: Quando si carica o scarica materiale occorre indossare i guanti protettivi solo d’inverno, per evitare l’intorpidimento delle dita, l’estate è invece più sicuro manovrare senza, perché si ha migliore sensibilità

records.localized_text: When loading or unloading material, protective gloves are needed only in winter to prevent numb fingers; in summer it is safer to work without gloves for better feel.

source.text_it: Per caricare o scaricare legname in tronchi di lunghezza superiore ai 7 metri, occorre la presenza a terra di una Guardia Forestale

records.localized_text: Loading or unloading logs over 7 metres long requires a forestry officer to be present on the ground.

source.text_it: E’ vietato circolare in autostrada con autoveicoli muniti di gru per il carico e scarico delle merci

records.localized_text: Motor vehicles fitted with cranes for loading and unloading goods are prohibited from traveling on motorways.

source.text_it: Gli autobus sono di norma muniti di porte e uscite di sicurezza

records.localized_text: Buses are normally equipped with doors and emergency exits.

source.text_it: Gli autobus sono di norma muniti di estintori

records.localized_text: Buses are normally equipped with fire extinguishers.

source.text_it: Gli autobus sono di norma muniti di cassetta del pronto soccorso

records.localized_text: Buses normally have a first-aid kit.

source.text_it: Gli estintori presenti a bordo degli autobus devono essere revisionati ogni 6 mesi

records.localized_text: Fire extinguishers on buses must be inspected every 6 months.

source.text_it: Gli autobus con un numero di posti a sedere non superiore a 30 posti devono essere muniti di un estintore a schiuma da 5 litri o a neve carbonica da 2 chilogrammi

records.localized_text: Buses with no more than 30 seats must have a 5-litre foam extinguisher or a 2-kilogram carbon dioxide extinguisher.

source.text_it: Gli autobus fino a 22 posti a sedere devono essere dotati di 3 uscite di emergenza

records.localized_text: Buses with up to 22 seats must have 3 emergency exits.

source.text_it: Gli autobus fino a 35 posti a sedere devono essere dotati di 4 uscite di emergenza

records.localized_text: Buses with up to 35 seats must have 4 emergency exits.

source.text_it: Gli autobus oltre i 35 posti a sedere devono essere dotati di 5 uscite di emergenza

records.localized_text: Buses with more than 35 seats must have 5 emergency exits.

source.text_it: I veicoli aventi massa complessiva a pieno carico maggiore di 3,5 tonnellate devono essere muniti di una coppia di cunei

records.localized_text: Vehicles with a total laden mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes must have a pair of wheel chocks.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus, gli spazi riservati alle sedie a rotelle devono essere obbligatoriamente muniti di sistemi di ritenuta

records.localized_text: Spaces reserved for wheelchairs on buses must be fitted with restraint systems.

source.text_it: Almeno un estintore in dotazione agli autobus deve essere sistemato in prossimità del sedile del conducente

records.localized_text: At least one bus fire extinguisher must be placed near the driver's seat.

source.text_it: I veicoli aventi massa complessiva a pieno carico maggiore di 3,5 tonnellate devono essere muniti di almeno due coppie di cunei

records.localized_text: Vehicles with a total laden mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes must have at least two pairs of wheel chocks.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus, gli spazi riservati alle sedie a rotelle non devono essere obbligatoriamente muniti di sistemi di ritenuta

records.localized_text: Spaces reserved for wheelchairs on buses are not required to have restraint systems.

source.text_it: Tutti gli estintori in dotazione agli autobus devono essere sistemati in prossimità del sedile del conducente

records.localized_text: All bus fire extinguishers must be placed near the driver's seat.

source.text_it: Gli autobus sono di norma muniti di tester per il rilevamento di assunzione sostanze alcoliche

records.localized_text: Buses normally have an alcohol-use testing device.

source.text_it: Gli autobus sono di norma muniti di almeno 3 porte e uscite di sicurezza

records.localized_text: Buses normally have at least 3 doors and emergency exits.

source.text_it: Gli autobus con numero di passeggeri superiore a 17 devono essere muniti di almeno 2 cassette del pronto soccorso

records.localized_text: Buses carrying more than 17 passengers must have at least 2 first-aid kits.

source.text_it: Gli estintori presenti a bordo degli autobus devono essere revisionati ogni 12 mesi

records.localized_text: Fire extinguishers on buses must be inspected every 12 months.

records.localized_text: Buses with up to 30 seats must have a 2-litre foam extinguisher or a 5-kilogram carbon dioxide extinguisher.

source.text_it: Gli autobus oltre i 22 posti a sedere devono essere dotati di 3 uscite di emergenza

records.localized_text: Buses with more than 22 seats must have 3 emergency exits.

source.text_it: Gli autobus oltre i 35 posti a sedere devono essere dotati di 4 uscite di emergenza

records.localized_text: Buses with more than 35 seats must have 4 emergency exits.

rows.text: Suitable gloves protect against handling risks in summer too: their selection depends on the risks of the work, not the season.
evidence: INAIL, Movimentazione manuale dei carichi, https://www.inail.it/portale/prevenzione-e-sicurezza/it/come-fare-per/conoscere-il-rischio/ergonomia/movimentazione-manuale-dei-carichi.html: valutazione dei rischi e uso di DPI idonei come i guanti.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: safe log handling depends on planning, suitable equipment, competent operators and an exclusion zone; a signaller may be needed. Length over 7 m alone does not establish a general requirement for a forest officer.
evidence: Official superiori question 28803 prints FALSO; no claim to exhaustively rule out local Italian forestry permissions.

HSE https://www.hse.gov.uk/WORKPLACETRANSPORT/checklist/section6.htm and OSHA https://www.osha.gov/etools/logging/manual-operations/log-loading-transport describe planning, equipment and exclusion/signalling precautions; UK/US technical guidance, not Italian law.

rows.text: A crane for handling goods does not by itself prohibit a motor vehicle from using a motorway. A vehicle classified as a work machine is different and is subject to the exclusions for that category.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 175 commi 2 e 3, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-175/: esclusioni per categorie, fra cui macchine operatrici, e relative eccezioni.

rows.text: Doors provide ordinary access; emergency exits offer additional escape routes when needed.
evidence: Regolamento ONU n. 107, allegato 3, punti 7.6.1.1 e 7.6.1.4, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX%3A42026X0139: porte di servizio e uscite per evacuazione.

rows.text: On-board extinguishers allow a small fire to be tackled early; they must be suitable for their intended use and kept in working order.
evidence: Circolare MIT e Interno 23 marzo 2018 n. 6575, https://www.patente.it/normativa/circolare-23-03-2018-n-6575-estintori-autobus?idc=3724: dotazione di estintori approvati sugli autobus e manutenzione.

rows.text: The kit holds the materials needed for first aid and is kept in a designated compartment.
evidence: MIT, quiz ispettori modulo B, decreto 520/2025, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2025-12/Allegato%20decreto%20520%20DD%20quiz.pdf: una o più cassette in apposite sedi e controllo del contenuto.

rows.text: The extinguisher’s periodic inspection is every six months. The quiz calls it “revision”, but inspection is not necessarily the same as a technical overhaul and replacement of the extinguishing agent.
evidence: MIT, quiz CQC 2021, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2021-10/20211012%20-%20flusso%20Poligrafico%20per%20Editori.txt%20-%20Blocco%20note.pdf: controllo da non più di sei mesi; Portale dell’automobilista quiz revisione 28877, https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI23-10.pdf/8673967c-c17e-421d-8f67-b711a33194c1: è falso che ogni sei mesi si debba svuotare e ricaricare.

rows.text: The quiz refers to the equipment specified by the 1977 decree: up to 30 seats, one 5-litre foam extinguisher or one 2 kg CO₂ extinguisher. A later circular also recognises an approved water-based extinguisher of at least 6 litres as equivalent.
evidence: DM 18 aprile 1977 allegato punto 5.5.8.1, testo riportato in https://www.asaps.it/downloads/ilcentauro/rivista/2018/4/page_flip/files/assets/common/downloads/Centauro_211.pdf; circolare MIT e Interno 23 marzo 2018 n. 6575, https://www.patente.it/normativa/circolare-23-03-2018-n-6575-estintori-autobus?idc=3724: equivalenza da 6 litri.

rows.text: The quiz marks this VERO. The 1977 Italian decree required buses and school buses to have at least 3 emergency exits for up to 22 passengers, 4 for 23–35 and 5 above 35, excluding the driver. A service door counts only if it meets emergency requirements; the question instead refers to seats. Check the rules applicable to the approved vehicle.
evidence: Official superiori source prints the stated VERO/FALSO.

DM 18 April 1977, Gazzetta Ufficiale 19 May 1977 supplement, §5.6.2.1.1 and §5.6.4.1.2, printed p.7, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/1977/05/19/135/so/0/sg/pdf ; visually inspected /tmp/rotonda-gu-1977-supplement-page7.png, PDF SHA-256 fc395ed35fa70499c519865e91fcaed1838bf8535c961667b4794d6245696f50. Historical rule explicitly counts emergency exits by passengers excluding driver, not solely seats; eligible service doors may count. Scope is historical; current approved rules must be checked.
UNECE R107 https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2020/R107r7e.pdf : applicable approved vehicle rules may differ.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: a pair of chocks helps prevent a parked heavy vehicle from rolling accidentally, particularly on a steep slope. ASAPS educational guidance describes two chocks for vehicles and trailers over 3.5 tonnes.
evidence: Official superiori question 28813 VERO. ASAPS educational article https://www.asaps.it/986-Comportamento_del_conducente_in_sosta_e_uso_di_cunei_fermaruote_per_i_veicoli_pesanti.html describes two chocks for vehicles/trailers over 3.5 t; local /tmp/rotonda-asaps-heavy-vehicle-chocks.txt inspected. DPR 495/1992 art.353(2) addresses use on steep slopes, not the number.

rows.text: The quiz marks this VERO. Wheelchair safety depends on the approved configuration: some use restraints, while eligible rear-facing positions use a suitable support.
evidence: Official superiori quiz prints the recorded verdict; UNECE R107 Annex 8 https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2020/R107r7e.pdf permits specified rear-facing wheelchair accommodation with support in applicable configurations. Do not generalize to every bus.

rows.text: One extinguisher must be placed near the driver’s seat so it is within the driver’s reach.
evidence: DM 18 aprile 1977 allegato punto 5.5.8.1, https://www.asaps.it/downloads/ilcentauro/rivista/2018/4/page_flip/files/assets/common/downloads/Centauro_211.pdf: uno presso il sedile di guida.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: the guidance describes one pair of chocks for heavy vehicles, not a general requirement for two pairs. Chocks resist accidental movement; this does not prohibit carrying extras.
evidence: Official superiori question 28816 FALSO. ASAPS https://www.asaps.it/986-Comportamento_del_conducente_in_sosta_e_uso_di_cunei_fermaruote_per_i_veicoli_pesanti.html describes a pair; not proof extra pairs prohibited. DPR 495 art.353(2) concerns use on steep slopes and does not specify a count.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSO. Wheelchair safety depends on the approved configuration: some use restraints, while eligible rear-facing positions use a suitable support.
evidence: Official superiori quiz prints the recorded verdict; UNECE R107 Annex 8 https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2020/R107r7e.pdf permits specified rear-facing wheelchair accommodation with support in applicable configurations. Do not generalize to every bus.

rows.text: The requirement is for at least one extinguisher near the driver; it does not require all extinguishers to be placed there.
evidence: DM 18 aprile 1977 allegato punto 5.5.8.1, https://www.asaps.it/downloads/ilcentauro/rivista/2018/4/page_flip/files/assets/common/downloads/Centauro_211.pdf: uno o più estintori, uno presso il sedile di guida.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: an interface facilitating alcohol-interlock installation is not the same as a breath-test interlock installed on every bus. Some vehicles may nevertheless have one.
evidence: Official superiori question 28819 prints FALSO. Regulation (EU) 2021/1243 https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32021R1243 implements installation facilitation for alcohol interlocks; an interface is not the interlock itself. Applicability depends on category and transition dates; some vehicles can carry actual devices.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but the wording is ambiguous: the 1977 Italian table required at least three emergency exits in its lowest capacity band, and a qualifying service door could count. The question does not clarify whether doors and exits are counted separately; it does not mean every bus needs three service doors.
evidence: Official superiori source prints the stated VERO/FALSO.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: more than 17 passengers does not by itself determine that two first-aid kits are required. For example, one bus specification with at least 18 seats calls for one kit; check the equipment required for the vehicle.
evidence: Official superiori question 28821 FALSO. Catania AMT bus procurement specification https://www.amts.ct.it/bandi/Capitolatotecnico5busmetano26012015.pdf PDF p.11 (printed p.10) at least 18 seats and PDF p.47 (printed p.46) one first-aid kit; local /tmp/rotonda-catania-bus-mirror-spec.pdf SHA-256 a5b747b842c8af85afa5355999e1b8bfe7b3a48abb1f6c4a2bed8693b76808f6 inspected. This is a concrete vehicle specification, not exhaustive law.

rows.text: Twelve months is too long for the periodic inspection: the quiz requires a check every six months. This check is distinct from the extinguisher’s technical overhaul.
evidence: MIT, quiz CQC 2021, https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2021-10/20211012%20-%20flusso%20Poligrafico%20per%20Editori.txt%20-%20Blocco%20note.pdf: controllo entro sei mesi; Portale dell’automobilista quiz revisione 28877, https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI23-10.pdf/8673967c-c17e-421d-8f67-b711a33194c1: svuotamento e ricarica non sono semestrali.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but the alternative is ambiguous: under the historical reference for up to 30 seats, 2 litres of foam is below the 5-litre minimum; an appropriate approved 5 kg CO₂ extinguisher can instead meet the 2 kg minimum. Check the requirements applicable to the vehicle.
evidence: Official superiori question 28823 prints FALSO. Approved current equivalent and applicable equipment should be verified.

issues: 28820: The question says buses normally have at least 3 doors and safety exits; it does not mention seat numbers. The repeated explanation incorrectly claims it refers to seats. Moreover the historical decree itself requires at least 3 emergency exits for buses in the smallest passenger category, so quoting that table without explaining the apparent conflict does not explain FALSO. State the actual limits and visible uncertainty and distinguish service doors from qualifying emergency exits without asserting that counts cannot overlap.

28823: The source offers alternative 2-litre foam or 5-kg CO₂. As with 28884, the CO₂ alternative may meet the historical minimum if suitable and approved; acknowledge the resulting ambiguity of the printed FALSO rather than listing the two facts without addressing the alternative.
reviewer_evidence: Visually inspected original 1977 Gazzetta supplement printed p.7, /tmp/rotonda-gu-1977-supplement-page7.png: §5.6.2.1.1 shows 3/4/5 emergency exits by 0–22/23–35/>35 passengers excluding driver; §5.6.4.1.2 gives requirements for remote service door to count as an emergency exit.

Inspected original 1977 supplement printed p.6 and 2018 joint circular in previous round: historical 5 L foam or 2 kg CO₂ up to 30 places, and approved modern CO₂ units at least 2 kg can be equivalent.
Independently read ASAPS chocks article local extraction and Catania 84-page specification PDF pages 11 and 47; neither establishes every conceivable legal obligation.
